messages:
karen (AE): Heads up — AcmeHealth escalated to execs. CTO says they won't sign off without BYO KMS + dedicated capacity SLA (99.9%) and a short pricing runbook. We need a clear path to unblock them by EOD. Can SE + Infra confirm feasibility? cc @sanjay

mike (SE): Quick Qs — which model/profile, expected peak rps and token distribution, and are they insisting on Private (VPC) or would Dedicated (our managed pool) be acceptable?

karen (AE): They want private control plane + customer-managed keys, but they've also asked for a dedicated GPU pool if private cadence is slow. Target workload: ~50k requests/day, ~40–60 rps peaks, median prompt ~120 tokens, completions ~180 tokens. Model: "redwood-2-large" or equivalent; latency target ~<250ms p50. Timeline: POC must demo next Tue (7 business days).

jules (Security): BYO KMS + VPC is doable, but we'll need key attestation and a KMS integration runbook. Legal will want a clause re: key access; also provide SOC2 report and vendor questionnaire answers. I can start the security Q.

ash (typo fix)

ash not participant - ignore

ash (Eng-Infra): I can stand up a Dedicated pool for the POC. Rough plan: 2 x A100 equivalent GPUs with preempt-safe autoscaling and warm cache. For BYO KMS we need their key ARN and an IAM role with kms:Decrypt/kms:Encrypt permissions; for on-prem we need a gateway. Estimated infra lead time: 48–72 hrs to provision staging capacity + routing.

ash (continuation as ash): Minimal runbook snippet to hand off to customer-facing docs:
```
1) Provision Dedicated pool: redwoodctl pool create --name acme-poc --gpus 2 --type dedicated
2) KMS bind: redwoodctl kms bind --pool acme-poc --key-arn arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789:key/XXXX
3) VPC peering: open ticket to infra for asymmetric NAT + allowlist cidr 10.11.12.0/24
4) Route policy: route: dedicated -> private-fallback -> hosted (if capacity)
```
I'll need the customer's key ARN and their VPC CIDR to start.

mike (SE): For model parity, we'll serve a quantized variant to hit the latency target; we can keep identical eval prompts. Also recommend enabling KV prefix caching for repeated prompts to reduce effective latency/cost. I can prepare a short perf matrix.

 tara (Finance): Pricing quick sketch: reserved capacity (2 GPUs) = $40k/mo baseline (committed). Suggest offering a 3-month POC discount at 50% applied to first month and prorated credits for overage. If they want BYO KMS + Private, there is an integration setup fee $8k one-time (engineering/secure onboarding). Will finalize numbers with legal for contract.

mike (SE): Action for eng: can you confirm we can meet 250ms p50 for redwood-2-large on 2 x A100 with our quantized kernel and caching? If not, we need to propose a faster instance or more GPUs.

ash (Eng-Infra): I can validate perf today in staging once I have the model binary or sha and seq length distribution. Right now estimate p50 ~280ms without KV cache. With caching + correct batching we should hit p50 ~210ms.

jules (Security): I'll run the security questionnaire; attach answers and SOC2 copy by EOD. Also need to schedule an engineers-only call for KMS attestation and key handling procedure. Proposed time: tomorrow 10:30am PT.

karen (AE): Draft note to CTO (please edit): "We can support your BYO KMS and a dedicated GPU pool for the POC. Engineering estimates 48–72hrs to provision a staging pool, and SE expects latency targets to be met with caching. Finance proposes a short POC discount and a one-time integration fee for secure onboarding. Next steps: please provide KMS key ARN, VPC CIDR, and a preferred time for KMS attestation call."

sanjay (Head of Sales): Solid. Mike/Jules/Ash — please get the one-page risk + timeline summary in the next 3 hrs so I can share with the CEO and Acme CTO. We want a single slide with: feasibility (yes/no), blockers (list), ETA to provision, and pricing snapshot.

mike (SE): I'll put together the slide deck (1 slide) with perf numbers and fallback plan.

ash (Eng-Infra): I'll create the pool and open infra ticket. Ticket: IR-17201 — provisioning acme-poc dedicated pool. ETA: 60hrs to production parity, but staging within 24–48hrs.

deploy-bot: Created ticket IR-17201 assigned to ash (Eng-Infra). ETA: 48h staging, 60h prod parity.

tara (Finance): I'll draft the POC quote and pricing terms, including the 1-time integration fee. Need to know whether we bill prepay or invoice net30.

karen (AE): Thanks — action items: 1) @ash create staging pool & share endpoint, 2) @mike create slide + perf matrix, 3) @jules security Q + SOC2, 4) @tara POC quote. I'll ping the customer after we have staging endpoint and slide.

sanjay (Head of Sales): If we can hit staging by EOD tomorrow, I'm comfortable taking this to execs. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
